name: Muneyama Ikuru
source:
The protagonist.

He is bold and thick-skinned, remaining unfazed by anything. Since childhood, he has spent his days being more or less forced into lewd things by his younger sister and childhood friend.

He has a positive personality and a strong drive to improve.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1353093]Getchu[/url]]
